definition: A scene of wild and noisy confusion involving many people.
author: James Matthew Barrie
quote: The pandemonium above has ceased almost as suddenly as it arose, passed like a fierce gust of wind; but they know that in the passing it has determined their fate.
example_sentence: Pandemonium broke out when the puppy got into the classroom.
